criteria.requirement: Extend Median and Percentiles to TimeDelta columns while preserving the existing CDF rank rule and Number behavior. Return timedelta values and report a TimeDelta aggregate type for Median. Ignore nulls using the existing warning policy, return None values for empty data, and compute duration midpoints without overflow at timedelta extremes or floating-point loss. Fractional microseconds round to nearest even. Preserve original source tests and Quantiles behavior.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
